label: few-shot calibration — LOW anchor
artifact: illustrative, not an FSK product — a generic scaffolded admin CRUD
description: Unstyled/minimally-styled table-and-form admin: default browser form controls, a bare <table> with no visual hierarchy, no empty states, raw field names as labels, identical look to every other scaffolded CRUD you have ever seen.

design_quality.evidence: No spacing rhythm (form fields touch each other), no typographic scale (every text node is the same 13px), default blue hyperlink color used for buttons, table has no header emphasis.

originality.evidence: This is the unmodified default look of a scaffolding tool — indistinguishable from a thousand other generated admin panels. No color/type/layout decision was made.

craft.evidence: Raw camelCase field names as labels ('createdAt', 'isActive'), booleans rendered as literal 'true'/'false' text, empty list renders as a bare table with a header row and nothing below it.

functionality.evidence: CRUD technically works — you can create/edit/delete — but pagination is missing and search silently does nothing on empty query.

verdict_note: Below threshold on design_quality and originality — the two axes this criteria file exists to enforce. This is the shape of a FAILING witness.
